newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour to send out manifesto to business.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour to send out manifesto to business.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party is planning to send out an election manifesto to business leaders pledging a "firm but fair" public sector pay policy and not to return to the corporate state of the 1960s and 1970s, The Sunday Times said.
It said the document, which would also pledge to keep inflation at 2.5 percent or below, was set to be approved at a meeting of the Labour shadow cabinet on Wednesday.
The Sunday Times said it had been drawn up after consultations with the director general of the Confederation of British Industry (CBI).
The document is also expected to include a Labour pledge to keep union reforms of the 1980s and to aim for high levels of employment.
